# RUMC machine recipe guide
[textlink="Back to Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"]
Every recipe currently loaded for a RUMC production machine or work station is listed below. Choose a machine, then search by product, ingredient or equipment. This catalog reads the same prototypes as the machines, so new recipes appear here automatically.
Select a result to see its exact inputs, outputs, processing time, circuit setting, temperature, reusable mold or catalyst, and compatible equipment. Choose how many batches to plan. Items marked [bold]kept[/bold] are not consumed.
[bold]Need an ingredient?[/bold] Click its row to open every known production or gathering source, including hand recipes, mining, drilling, plants and pumps. Use Back to return to the same machine and recipe. The quantities shown are the base recipe; upgrades and machine speed can change processing time.
